answer: Comet-Trail Tithing: each agent identity must attach a unique, verifiable work history signed by prior counterparties. Registration charges a small fee routed to a shared lagoon pool, but the real cost is that every clone needs a fresh, non-replayable history; forging one triggers a ripple of retroactive audits across all linked transactions. A clone's expected gain stays below the combined fee plus audit exposure, so each marginal identity is strictly negative-EV.
